kind_rules.face: starts with face >=150 px, face score gate

shots.start_frame: darkness; the round blue-glowing port on the nape of Astra's neck, silver hair strands, black collar armor
shots.motion: the blue ring slowly pulses brighter and dimmer twice
shots.sfx: low hum power-up, deep sub swell

shots.start_frame: extreme close-up of Astra's closed eye and the blue chevron on her left cheek, warm candle glow
shots.motion: her eyelids open slowly, light blue iris, candle flame reflected; the chevron lights up

shots.start_frame: Astra lying on a stone table, head turned toward camera in 3/4, eyes open, candlelight from the side
shots.motion: she slowly sits up, rooted, eyes looking past camera toward the window

shots.start_frame: the maker (old man, dark-brown robe, seen from behind) stands at the arched window looking at the dead sun; Astra stands behind him in 3/4 view, face toward camera
shots.motion: ash drifts past the window; the old man's shoulders rise and fall; Astra stays still

shots.start_frame: over the old man's shoulder (dark-brown robe, grey hair, back to camera, left of frame): his arm extended holding the glowing brass lantern out toward Astra, who stands at the right of frame facing him and camera in 3/4 view with both armored hands raised open, ready to take it
shots.motion: the old man places the lantern into her hands; her armored hands close around the handle; he lets go and his hands withdraw; at the end she holds the lantern at her chest

shots.start_frame: Astra holding the brass lantern at chest height, warm flame lighting her face from below, blue rim from her LEDs
shots.motion: she lowers her eyes to the flame; the flame breathes

shots.start_frame: the old man in his dark-brown robe seated at the oak workbench, seen from behind and to the side, slumped forward, a single lit candle beside him, warm light
shots.motion: the candle flame gutters and goes out, a curl of smoke rises; nobody moves

shots.start_frame: Astra's face in 3/4 view, lit by the lantern, the window's grey light behind her
shots.motion: she closes her eyes slowly; the blue chevron on her cheek pulses slowly twice

shots.start_frame: seen from behind: Astra standing just inside a tall open arched stone doorway (no window) of the tower room that opens onto a mountain ledge, lantern gripped in her right hand, ash blowing in, pale dead sun outside
shots.motion: she steps forward through the doorway onto the ledge; ash falls

shots.start_frame: vast grey ash valley with colossal half-buried fallen stone statues, ashfall, dead pale sun disc, one warm lantern glow far away in the middle
shots.motion: ash falls slowly; haze drifts; nothing else moves

shots.start_frame: Astra walking toward camera through ash, lantern held forward, ash dust on her shoulders and hair, a fallen statue head behind her
shots.motion: she walks steadily toward camera; ash falls

shots.start_frame: Astra in 3/4 view holding the brass lantern close to her chest, wind blowing ash, her right armored hand curved around the lantern, face lit warm from below
shots.motion: she draws the lantern closer and shields the flame with her hand; the flame steadies; ash streams past; she is rooted

shots.start_frame: Astra's face, lantern light from below, ash particles in the air
shots.motion: she stops; her eyes shift sharply to the side; the blue lines on her collar brighten

shots.start_frame: grey ash dunes between broken statues
shots.motion: tall faceless figures of dark ash rise out of the dunes, ember-orange eyes igniting

shots.start_frame: Astra in a low fighting stance, feet apart, knees bent, her right arm extended forward with the open palm facing forward and a perfectly straight rigid blade of bright blue energy projecting straight out of her palm, the brass lantern held low in her left hand
shots.motion: she holds the fighting stance and takes a slow guarded step forward, the straight rigid blade of blue energy from her palm stays perfectly straight and rigid

shots.start_frame: an ash wraith lunging, a blue energy blade swinging in from the left of frame
shots.motion: the blue blade slices through the wraith, which explodes into a cloud of ash and embers

shots.start_frame: Astra mid-strike, blue blade raised, lantern held back, ash wraiths around her
shots.motion: she brings the blade down; the wraith before her bursts into ash

shots.start_frame: Astra's face lit by the blue blade, ash and embers swirling
shots.motion: her eyes track left to right, fierce and calm

shots.start_frame: seen from behind: Astra on a dune crest holding the glowing brass lantern by its handle in her right hand at her side, dozens of ash wraiths rising across the valley ahead, an ancient stone bridge far away
shots.motion: she runs forward down the dune toward the far bridge

shots.start_frame: a narrow stone bridge over a chasm in an ash storm, lightning, a small figure of Astra running with the lantern in the middle of the bridge
shots.motion: lightning flashes in the clouds; ash streams across; she keeps running steadily along the bridge

shots.start_frame: Astra running along the stone bridge in three-quarter side view, whole figure visible, lantern in hand, stones cracking behind her
shots.motion: she runs steadily along the bridge; stones behind her crack and drop

shots.start_frame: bridge paving stones and a broken balustrade
shots.motion: the stones crack apart and fall into the dark chasm

shots.start_frame: Astra landing on one knee on the bridge, the brass lantern gripped by its handle in her right hand and held up beside her, right shoulder plate cracked, sparks at her knee
shots.motion: sparks scatter; she lifts her head

shots.start_frame: inside the lantern a tiny dying flame, almost an ember
shots.motion: the flame shrinks and nearly goes out

shots.start_frame: Astra's ash-streaked face, crack on her right shoulder plate, lightning rim light, looking down at the lantern
shots.motion: the LED line near her collar flickers; she looks at the flame

shots.start_frame: Astra kneeling in 3/4 view, ash-streaked face, cracked right shoulder plate, both armored hands cupped around the open brass lantern at chest height, tiny flame inside
shots.motion: a thread of blue light flows from her fingertips into the flame; the flame grows warm and bright and lights her face; she stays still

shots.start_frame: Astra standing on the bridge facing the swarm of ash wraiths approaching from the far side, the glowing brass lantern gripped in her left hand at her side, lightning flash behind
shots.motion: she rises to her feet, blade ready; lightning flashes

shots.start_frame: Astra kneeling with the blue blade raised in both hands above the bridge stones, lantern set beside her
shots.motion: she drives the blade down into the stones; a ring of blue light blasts outward

shots.start_frame: seen from behind: Astra standing at the far end of the bridge, the glowing brass lantern in her right hand at her side, the span behind her full of ash wraiths
shots.motion: a wave of blue light sweeps across the bridge and the ash creatures behind her dissolve into drifting ash and vanish; she stands still holding the lantern

shots.start_frame: Astra climbing the last stretch of a narrow rocky stone stairway up a cliff toward the colossal stone ring at the summit, lantern in her right hand, blue hour
shots.motion: she climbs the stairway steadily toward the ring, the lantern swinging gently at her side; clouds drift below

shots.start_frame: Astra kneeling at the brass brazier on the stone dais, lantern in her hands, blue hour light, her LEDs dim
shots.motion: she sets the lantern on the dais edge

shots.start_frame: the brass lantern on the stone dais with its glass door open and a dead blackened wick, Astra kneeling behind it out of focus with dim blue lines
shots.motion: a thin thread of smoke rises from the dead wick and fades; nothing else moves

shots.start_frame: Astra's ash-streaked face, lit only by her dim blue lines and the blue hour sky
shots.motion: stillness; she slowly lifts her eyes toward the ring

shots.start_frame: Astra kneeling in 3/4 view, blue hour, her right armored hand pressed flat on her chest plate, dim blue lines, eyes lowered
shots.motion: blue light gathers and brightens under her palm, lighting her chin and face from below; she stays still

shots.start_frame: Astra kneeling with one hand on the brazier rim, blue light flowing down her arm into the brazier
shots.motion: her blue armor lines go dark one by one from the boots upward as the light flows into the brazier

shots.start_frame: Astra's face, the blue chevron on her cheek fading, eyes open and calm
shots.motion: the chevron fades to dark; the faintest calm smile

shots.start_frame: the colossal stone ring and brazier at blue hour, a kneeling dark figure at its foot
shots.motion: the brazier ignites; white-gold light races around the ring and bursts outward over the clouds

shots.start_frame: seen from behind: a new golden sun rising inside the stone ring over the cloud sea, a dark figure kneeling at the brazier in the foreground-left, large enough to read
shots.motion: golden light floods across the clouds; god rays shift through the ring; the figure stays still

shots.start_frame: golden sunrise light raking across Astra's still face, eyes closed, armor lines dark
shots.motion: after a beat the blue chevron flickers on once; her eyes open
shots.sfx: one soft piano note, servo click

shots.start_frame: black, 'ASTRA' in thin wide light-blue letters with the chevron logo
shots.motion: letters fade in and out

notes: LTX traps (Lantern Path): no hand-only inserts (LTX invents people) → body+prop framing; no animated tiny far figures → far figures stay still; establishing shots use ambient motion only, no camera words.
